title: Notification Deadline for Top-Up Tax Further Extended
text:
GUIDANCE NOTE
Reference OGC No. 2/2026
Title
Notification for Top-Up Tax
Subtitle
Guidance on Top-Up Tax Notification Further Extended
This guidance provides information on the notification requirements
for Top-Up Tax and informs taxpayers that the previously granted
Purpose
administrative extension for submitting the notification has been
extended.
Notification Deadline for Top-Up Tax Further Extended
The Barbados Revenue Authority advises entities subject to the notification
requirements under Section 45 of the Corporation Top-Up Tax Act, 2024-16 that the
administrative extension previously granted for the submission of the Top-Up Tax
Notification has been further extended.
Entities that are required to notify the Authority that they are a qualifying entity for the
purposes of Top-Up Tax, and whose notification would otherwise have been due
during calendar year 2025 or on or before 6 March 2026, may now submit their
notification no later than 31 March 2026.
Any notification submitted within this extended period will be treated as having been
submitted on time for compliance purposes, and no penalty will apply solely by reason
of this administrative extension.
Notification must be effected through the completion and submission of the Top-Up
Tax Registration Form via the Global Relations Portal of the Barbados Revenue
Authority, accessible at: https://globalrelations.bra.gov.bb
Entities must first register on the Portal and obtain login credentials to access and
complete the registration form.
Any queries regarding Top-Up Tax may be submitted to topuptax@bra.gov.bb.
The Barbados Revenue Authority encourages all affected entities to ensure their
notifications are submitted within the extended timeframe.
Policy Unit
Office of the General Counsel and Policy
Barbados Revenue Authority
6 March 2026
ALL CORRESPONDENCE MUST BE ADDRESSED TO THE REVENUE COMMISSIONER
